password_reset.subject: Reset your {{site_name}} password
password_reset.body:
Let's get you back in.

Someone asked to reset the password on your account. If that was you, set a new one below.

{{reset_button}}

{{request_box}}

Not you? Ignore this email and your password won't change. If it keeps happening, {{support_link}}.

magic_link.subject: Your sign-in link for {{site_name}}
magic_link.body:
Sign in to {{site_name}}

Click the button below to sign in. This link expires in {{expiry_minutes}} minutes and can only be used once.

{{login_button}}

If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without the link.

email_verify.subject: Verify your email — {{site_name}}
email_verify.body:
Verify your email

Enter this code in the registration form to complete your account setup. It expires in {{expiry_minutes}} minutes.

{{code_box}}

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

email_change.subject: Your email change verification code — {{site_name}}
email_change.body:
Confirm your new email

Enter this code to confirm {{new_email}} as your new email address. It expires in {{expiry_minutes}} minutes.

{{code_box}}

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email — your address is unchanged.

smtp_test.subject: SMTP test — {{site_name}}
smtp_test.body:
Outbound mail works

This is the test message from {{site_name}}. If you are reading it, the SMTP settings in your ACP are correct and mail is leaving the server.

Sent from {{site_url}}

twofactor_enabled.title: Two-factor sign-in is on
twofactor_enabled.detail: Two-factor sign-in was turned on for your account. From now on, signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app. Your other sessions were signed out.

twofactor_disabled.title: Two-factor sign-in was turned off
twofactor_disabled.detail: Two-factor sign-in was turned off for your account. Signing in no longer asks for a code from your authenticator app.

recovery_used.title: A recovery code was used
recovery_used.detail: One of your recovery codes was just used instead of your authenticator app. Each code works once.

recovery_regenerated.title: You have new recovery codes
recovery_regenerated.detail: New recovery codes were made for your account. The old ones no longer work.

twofactor_reset.title: An admin turned off your two-factor sign-in
twofactor_reset.detail: An admin removed two-factor sign-in from your account and signed you out everywhere. You can turn it on again in your account settings.

twofactor_disabled_admin.title: {{username}} turned off two-factor sign-in
twofactor_disabled_admin.detail: {{username}} must use two-factor sign-in and just turned it off. The admin panel stays closed to them until it is on again.

recovery_used_admin.title: {{username}} used a recovery code
recovery_used_admin.detail: {{username}} must use two-factor sign-in and just used a one-time recovery code instead of their authenticator app.

twofactor_reset_admin.title: Two-factor sign-in was removed from {{username}}
twofactor_reset_admin.detail: An admin removed two-factor sign-in from {{username}} and signed them out everywhere.
